platform.name: Linux GNOME
platform.formatLimit: The Impeccable platform enum and HTML specimen format do not represent GTK. Native component details are stored here; no web platform or HTML component is implied.

body.purpose: Single-line session rows. Inherit the GTK font family.

label.purpose: Text state at the end of each row. Inherit the GTK font family.

muted.purpose: Idle and Unknown labels without Pending attention, plus captions.

highlight.method: Mix encoded RGB channels, then round each channel.

editorSeed.accentFallback: Use foreground if accent contrast against background is below 4.5:1.
editorSeed.note: These fractions seed the custom editor. They do not change GNOME colors.

behavior.apply: Validate, atomically save, then apply in the current ASB window.
behavior.pickerChange: Does not apply until Apply theme is activated.
behavior.reset: Delete the custom file and restore GNOME roles.
behavior.invalidInput: Show the error; retain the applied theme and saved file.
behavior.invalidSavedTheme: Show the error and retain GNOME mode.

layout.measurement: The Gtk.ScrolledWindow allocation, not whole-window size.
layout.columnWidth: Equal width across the horizontal strip.
layout.flow: Down each column, then across; needed columns continue left to right without vertical pages or empty trailing columns.
layout.note: Checked sizes are evidence, not fixed window breakpoints.

sharedColumnWidth.save: After drag end or menu value change.
sharedColumnWidth.reset: 240px; remove saved width and preserve optional view.
sharedColumnWidth.narrow360px: One default column, or two at 160px.

toolbar.pendingAndCount: Inline at 680px or wider; second short row below.
toolbar.filters: Native Codex/Claude/Pending toggle pills, inline at680px or secondary row below; count ellipsizes at320px.
toolbar.settingsDismissal: Keep focus in open popup during repack. Native autohide and one root outside-click hit test dismiss it; restore remembered row after close.

comfortable.direction: Workspace first: provider/folder/quiet pin, fixed32px two-line title, dot/state left and relative age right.

views.persistence: Optional view in ASB layout.json; width-only means Compact; width/reset preserves view.

layout.wheel: Native scroll controller maps ordinary wheel Y to horizontal adjustment; trackpad X and Shift-wheel remain usable.

focus.restore: Preserve focused session ID and clamped horizontal position. Normal refresh keeps user position; keyboard, mode changes and resize reveal focused rows.

keyboard.Enter: Activate a row with a valid desktop link.
keyboard.Printable row typing: Focus search and enter the character from any non-editable area; preserve modified shortcuts and editable/popup/control keys.
keyboard.Escape: Close native popup first; otherwise clear query/prefix and preserve explicit filters.

nativeComponents.name: Session row
nativeComponents.activation: Single click or Enter opens a valid desktop link; missing links disable activation.
tooltip: Pin or missing-link details when applicable
nativeComponents.opening: Opening… replaces only title; restore current title on completion. Inline tooltip/description for failures.
comfortableContent: Folder basename and optional quiet ASB pin
Relative age right, ellipsized as needed
nativeComponents.sharedBehavior: Same opening label, tooltip, accessible name, focus, row menu and pin drag.

nativeComponents.name: Provider mark
nativeComponents.purpose: Gray provider identity; the row accessible name contains the full provider name.

nativeComponents.name: Unread dot
nativeComponents.color: GNOME accent or custom palette accent.
nativeComponents.purpose: Current unacknowledged ASB attention, independent of execution. Native/manual/completion/question sources stay distinct.

nativeComponents.name: Search and filters
nativeComponents.pendingSwitch: Pending toggle pill in main toolbar; accessible name Pending only.
nativeComponents.count: Filtered session count and filtered Pending count.

prefixes.behavior: Case-insensitive; optional spaces; prefix temporarily overrides app filter; unknown prefix stays literal.

states.clear: No selected states hides all sessions.

nativeComponents.name: Session row menu
nativeComponents.action: Read or Unread from current ASB dot
nativeComponents.scope: ASB state only; pin order comes first and remains global across filters.
actions: Read if unread or questionAttention; otherwise Unread
nativeComponents.activation: Defer popup unparent until GTK completes action activation.

statePresentation.idlePendingLabel: Idle; Pending attention is shown by the dot, not a task state.
statePresentation.manualUnread: Add the dot and Pending attention; preserve Working, Waiting, and Unknown labels.
statePresentation.waiting: Keep Waiting text; include in Pending attention.
statePresentation.customStateColor: Working, Waiting, and Pending share accent; text labels remain distinct.
statePresentation.nativeUnread: Dot for a new native unread episode. Local ASB acknowledgment suppresses it until a real Read-to-Unread cycle or new completion; source read truth remains unchanged.
statePresentation.pinScope: ASB-owned only; original-app pins are not imported.
statePresentation.userQuestion: Current synchronous question can block Waiting; async request adds attention without masking Working/Idle. Human resumption supersedes old requests. Goal/context continuation and partial replies preserve them. ASB open acknowledges local attention without resolving source input.
statePresentation.readAcknowledgment: Default successful open clears local manual, completion, native and question attention. Read always clears local attention. Neither changes execution or original stores.
statePresentation.persistentUnread: Off by default. When on, retain ASB attention across source read/resolution and opens. Read clears it. Disabling retains existing dots and restores acknowledgment on open.

verificationLimits: The current code checks custom background and highlight contrast and supplies field-specific color-control names.
This record does not claim a complete assistive-technology audit.
Performance changes use syntax and pure logic checks. No native widget or screenshot check ran for this change.

appIdentity.registration: Scoped per-user hicolor icon and desktop entry; preserve conflicting user launchers.

pinReorder.accepted: Only an active local ASB pin drag onto another known ASB pin.
pinReorder.keyboard: Move pin earlier/later in row menu.
pinReorder.persistence: pinnedOrder in ASB pending.json; preserve hidden pins.

filterPills.selection: One set shared with app menu. No selected provider or both means all; one means that provider.
filterPills.pending: AND filter using existing ASB attention.
filterPills.prefix: Temporarily overrides selected apps while present.

persistentUnread.help: Use Read in the row menu to clear dots.
persistentUnread.scope: Shared ASB tracker state, separate from layout/theme.
persistentUnread.synchronization: Dashboard sync does not write; disable during request, restore value and show error on failure.
persistentUnread.presentation: retainedUnread has a 7px dot and an ASB-specific tooltip/accessibility cue; current state stays visible.

refresh.scope: Any unarchived root Working session in the complete scanned list before filters. Keep the same cadence when another app has focus.
refresh.events: Local /api/events dashboard events with version/reason/provider flags only. No filenames or content. Connected is not a dirty hint.
refresh.nativeEventReader: Background stdlib HTTP stream. Close interrupts its socket read. EOF or failure retries in five seconds. Polling remains available.
refresh.fallback: Watch failure uses two seconds while Working and five seconds when idle. Missing/unsupported watch paths retry or use directory discovery.
refresh.behavior: One read in flight and at most one pending follow-up. Source hints do not force scans. Keyed rows update fields in place; only visible IDs, order, packing, or view changes repack rows. Activity alone does not rewrite tracker state.
refresh.geometry: Gdk.Surface layout signal with one queued idle check. No permanent frame callback.
refresh.rowLifetime: Disconnect handlers and remove controllers when a row leaves the view.

workingTime.source: Stable workingSinceMs from the current source task/request; 0 means unavailable.
workingTime.comfortable: Replace relative age with duration in the right metadata label.
workingTime.format: Seconds/minutes below one hour; hours/minutes after one hour.
workingTime.update: Local two-second clock updates label, tooltip, and accessible text without I/O. Stop the fast clock when the full unarchived list has no Working session; refresh idle age once a minute.
workingTime.unavailable: Keep current state and normal age; never invent a start.

narrative.overview: ASB is a native GNOME session index with default Compact and chosen Workspace-first Comfortable. Both fill down-column/across in a horizontal strip with shared session behavior. Outer borders remain unchanged.
keyCharacteristics: Text labels for state and attention.

rules.name: The Local Theme Rule
rules.body: Apply colors only to ASB. Never change GNOME settings to match a preview.

rules.name: The Whole Row Rule
rules.body: Keep the provider mark, title, optional dot, and state together on one line.

dos: Do use native GNOME controls and semantic colors.
Do keep a text label for each state.
Do retain one-line rows and full tooltip details.
Do validate custom colors before saving or applying them.
donts: Don't add a browser or webview to the native window.
Don't treat all historical Idle sessions as Pending.
Don't replace Working, Waiting, or Unknown with Pending.
Don't pin a machine-specific theme, font, or accent as an ASB requirement.
